I could not verify this result, so the answer below is a low-confidence recollection rather than a derived or checked value.

The known analogues are 230 space groups falling into 219 abstract isomorphism classes, and 17 wallpaper groups all distinct. For the subperiodic cases, I believe a recent classification of abstract isomorphism among rod and layer groups gives fewer classes than the affine count, but I cannot reliably recall the exact numbers. My best guess is 52 rod-group classes and 54 layer-group classes, and you should check this against the original source before relying on it.

ANSWER: (52, 54)
